title: A new CI guard's standard record is added by one command, never a hand edit
body:
Evidence: lane of t-gxmzryy (#1389) needed four npm run fast runs to add one CI-rule record: test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts demands a record per test/rules guard, and hand edits of .agents/standards.json first reformatted the whole file (guard red), then truncated it (parse error).
Outcome: one krn standards command appends a CI-rule record for a new test/rules guard, byte-preserving the rest of .agents/standards.json; the ci-rule-coverage failure message names that command.
Proof: node --test test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts: exit 0
Files: src/brain/standards-cli.ts, test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts
